notes: Rows and marks are the 7 September 2026 statement snapshot, not live positions or quotes.
Signed Units are retained as signed_contracts; negative positions are labeled short and positive positions are labeled long.
displayed_contract_units preserves the trailing contract denomination in each description. valuation_multiplier is separately validated against quoted option price and signed USD mark.
Currency conversion uses the statement row FX rate conventions shown on the same printed page.
No underlying spot price is provided in the options table.
Covered and Blocked remarks are transcribed only when explicitly present. Absence of a remark is not proof of an uncovered position.
Current option marks are valuation snapshots, not expiration scenario values. No expiration payoff, assignment cost, margin requirement or premium profit is calculated in this extraction.
FUBO1 adjustment facts are retained from the official OCC memo cited in the dashboard.
Reconstruction differences of less than one USD arise from printed FX quotes rounded to four or fewer decimals; the signed statement marks reconcile exactly to the holdings subtotal.
